baseline.program_record_parent_drift: Survey work started from the parent commit; the parent ref advanced with a test-only hardening commit. Rebase onto the observed parent head before publication.
baseline.scope: Source, tests, tracked documentation, and forge metadata observed at the frozen baseline.

hypotheses.finding: The runtime exposes canonical DecisionReceipt issuance and execute_with_receipt enforcement with signature, expected-actor, and expiry checks; single-use is enforced when a consumption ledger is configured.
hypotheses.next_validation: Bind this runtime behavior into the managed canonical journey before promoting any managed-plane claim.

hypotheses.finding: The control-plane governance path imports Kernel and Receipt and dispatches the legacy receipt flow rather than the signed canonical DecisionReceipt executor flow.
hypotheses.next_validation: Add a dispatcher-level migration proof that exercises the canonical receipt and executor path.

hypotheses.finding: Control-plane audit storage is a per-organization JSONL chain and verification uses linear chain scans; this is not evidence of a horizontally scalable managed evidence system of record.
hypotheses.next_validation: Define a tenant-isolated metadata and retained-artifact design with measured replay behavior.

hypotheses.finding: The survey did not find an injected SQL-commit failure proof that determines whether an audit append can remain after the related SQL mutation rolls back.
hypotheses.evidence_class: gap identified by source and test inventory
hypotheses.next_validation: Add a transaction-failure integration test before asserting event and mutation atomicity.

hypotheses.finding: Control-plane exports provide hash manifests but no verified signed-provenance or independent-witness proof.
hypotheses.next_validation: Specify and test a proof-pack verifier that checks signature, provenance, receipt-event equivalence, and a separate checkpoint.

hypotheses.finding: The survey did not find a database uniqueness constraint, locked activation path, or concurrency test proving exactly one active policy under concurrent activation.
hypotheses.evidence_class: gap identified by source and test inventory
hypotheses.next_validation: Add a database invariant and concurrent activation integration test.

hypotheses.finding: The control plane initializes schema with create_all, has no Alembic migration surface, uses organization-scoped service-credential routes, and has no observed v1, idempotency, or transactional-outbox foundation.
hypotheses.next_validation: Build the migration, versioned API, idempotency, and outbox foundations before hosted-plane feature work.

hypotheses.finding: The surveyed source has local and MCP approval-resume capability, but the inventory did not find a managed control-plane approval/resume API or durable managed approval operation, nor the surveyed receipt-ingestion, signed-policy-sync, durable-spool, or independent-witness surfaces.
hypotheses.next_validation: Design the canonical native transaction spine before adding provider adapters.

hypotheses.finding: The console uses relative api-v1 and api-bus routes with a browser session and non-production fixture model; its observed contract does not match the control-plane organization-scoped service-credential surface.
hypotheses.evidence_class: local source and browser-boundary test summary
hypotheses.next_validation: Define and test one server-side browser-to-upstream boundary and generated or bidirectionally tested contracts.

hypotheses.finding: At the frozen observation, pull request 317 was open and draft, pull request 308 was open and unmerged, pull request 267 was closed and unmerged, and issues 167 and 168 were open.
hypotheses.next_validation: Re-survey forge state before accepting any branch, review, CI, release, or deployment conclusion.

hypotheses.finding: The control-plane package test snapshot passed 25 tests with a warning; the console authentication-boundary check passed under host Node 22 while its requested runtime is Node 24; the first gove-zone broad-gate cause was absent optional cryptography and PyYAML dependencies, and it was not rerun.
hypotheses.next_validation: Provision the declared optional dependencies and exact Node runtime in a clean environment, then rerun the authoritative package gates once.

capability_matrix.finding: Canonical local receipt and executor controls are present, but no accepted end-to-end managed journey connects them to enrollment, signed policy distribution, evidence ingestion, approvals, and proof export.
A local alpha control-plane surface exists, but it retains legacy receipt dispatch and lacks the surveyed migration, versioning, atomicity, and canonical enforcement evidence.
No surveyed external ingestion, durable spool, retained evidence system of record, independent witness, or signed managed proof-pack verifier exists.
The console contains tested browser boundaries and fixtures, while its observed API and session contract conflicts with the current control-plane service surface.
Release label and deployment metadata do not prove a deployed, monitored, recoverable, or customer-operated beta service.
